card.name: Linking words before echocardiogram or MUGA
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'by', 'using' or 'the' right after LVEF or ejection fraction is measured or evaluated, just before the method (echocardiogram, MUGA) is named.

modes.label: by after measured
modes.description: The word 'by' follows measured, detected, evaluated or assessed with LVEF, leading into echocardiography or MUGA.
modes.example: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) should be evaluated<< by>> echocardiogram or MUGA

modes.label: using before methodology
modes.description: 'using' or 'the' introduces the method of LVEF assessment in mitoxantrone cardiac monitoring.
